The '''crawlers''' were 134 [[Species/Legends|species]] of nearly two-dimensional life-forms that lived under high [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressures in the boundary between the atmosphere and core of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. Reaching sizes of several hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across and no more than two [[decimeter]]s in height, they constantly moved across the layer of [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] liquids that they inhabited, [[Diet/Legends|feeding]] on trace elements and [[Reproduction/Legends|reproducing]] by fission. Such activity led to the dislodgement of the valuable [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]] from Yavin Prime's core, followed by their rise to the higher levels of the planet's atmosphere. Although the crawlers were eventually discovered via long-range observations, no contact with the organisms had been made by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Eaw_Yavin.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The crawlers lived near the planetary core of Yavin Prime (pictured).]]
The crawlers were a group of 134 [[Species/Legends|species]] of organisms that lived on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]<ref name="GG2-2" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> They resided in the thick<ref name="CSWE Yavin">{{CSWECite|III|350|Yavin}}</ref> yet indistinct, slushy<ref name="GG2-2" /> layer of [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] liquids<ref name="CSWE Yavin" /> that served as the boundary between the lowest level of Yavin Prime's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], consisting of frozen [[Water/Legends|water]] and frozen [[liquid hydrogen]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], and the planet's [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]]-[[Helium/Legends|helium]] core. The atmospheric pressure on Yavin Prime ranged from five [[Standard Atmosphere]]s at the top of its [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] layer to more than a million Standard Atmospheres at the center of its core, and the core-atmosphere boundary inhabited by crawlers was also subject to tremendous pressure<ref name="GG2-2" /> that would crush most other life-forms.<ref name="CSWE Yavin" />

As a result, the crawlers were nearly two-dimensional, with their length and width dimensions exceeding many times the height they could attain&mdash;the organisms ranged in size from [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] across and approximately a [[Millimeter/Legends|millimeter]] high to several hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across and up to two [[decimeter]]s high. The smallest and largest crawlers were rag-shaped and blanket-shaped, respectively.<ref name="GG2-2" /> Although the twelve species<ref name="CSWE floater">{{CSWECite|I|281|floater (1)}}</ref> of [[Floater (creature)|floater]] that lived in the upper levels of Yavin Prime's atmosphere were still very resilient compared to the technology of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] originating off-world, they were fragile compared to the crawlers and would be torn to shreds by any contact with the latter.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behavior==
The crawlers [[Diet/Legends|fed]] on trace elements and [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduced]] by fission, and crawlers of all sizes constantly moved across the boundary layer that they inhabited. There, giant crawlers in their search for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] dislodged [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]]&mdash;highly valuable [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] produced in Yavin Prime's core<ref name="GG2-2" /> and [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on the planet beginning with approximately fifteen [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> of [[3996 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;sending them hurtling to the higher levels of the planet's atmosphere by its high-speed winds.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==History==
At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]] is set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the 134 species of crawlers were discovered via long-distance observations from high in Yavin Prime's atmosphere. They were assumed to be non-sentient despite no contact having been made&mdash;and the possibility that such contact may not be made for hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to come.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The crawlers&mdash;spelled as "Crawlers"&mdash;were introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> The organisms' name was subsequently spelled in lowercase form in [[Jonatha Ariadne Caspian]]'s [[1995]] [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] to the book,<ref name="GG2-2" /> a practice that then carried over to later sources as well.<ref name="CSWE Yavin" /><ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
